description: Freshness contract for every analytics artifact, the dbt marts, the semantic registry and the dashboard's inputs. Evaluated by `python3 -m pipeline check-freshness`; documented in pipeline/README.md.

artifacts.name: health_score
artifacts.fresh_means: Scores exist for the latest month and held-out validation was logged at the reference date.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Its usage-trend input is monthly, which bottlenecks the whole composite (dashboard grain table), so it refreshes at month close: one month plus a 4-day close window.

artifacts.name: segment_migration
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date covering all migration events to that date.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Migration events are evaluated against monthly usage and periodic firmographic rescoring; the monthly ARR bridge it reconciles to is monthly-only. One month plus a 4-day close window.

artifacts.name: marketing_attribution
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date with current holdout and pipeline-generated estimates.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Pipeline generated is weekly-capable but the holdout-based incrementality estimates need a month of matured lead outcomes before they move, so the artifact is refreshed at month close: one month plus a 4-day close window.

artifacts.name: capacity_planning
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date covering every complete quarter of attainment.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Quota and attainment are quarter-grain (rep-quarters), so nothing new exists between quarter closes. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window.

artifacts.name: forecast
artifacts.fresh_means: A validated forecast checkpoint exists within three weekly submission cycles of the last complete month end.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Submissions are weekly Friday snapshots, so the operating cadence is weekly. The validated checkpoint is mid-quarter (2025-11-14), the last point with a large enough open Commercial/Enterprise population to score; it sits 16 days behind the last complete month. 21 days = three submission cycles. Owner review item: a tighter SLA needs a later canonical checkpoint.

artifacts.name: data_quality_governance
artifacts.fresh_means: The governance report and logged check counts exist for the reference date, and every computed check passed.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Runs on every data rebuild so a dbt defect is caught while it is cheap to localize; checked weekly at minimum. One week plus a 3-day slip.

artifacts.name: deal_diagnostics
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged for the last complete month, when open Commercial/Enterprise pipeline still exists to score.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Sourced from opportunity and stage-history events, which the grain table marks weekly-capable, so the cadence is weekly (one week plus a 3-day slip). The open population is empty at the dataset's final date, which is why the canonical checkpoint is the last complete month.

artifacts.name: rep_productivity
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date over the full trailing window.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Peer benchmarks condition on ramp status and deal outcomes that need a quarter of closed deals to stabilize (methods doc). A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window.

artifacts.name: territory_coverage
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date against the current territory assignment.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Strategic and market-facing (build spec Wave 5, not part of the weekly cadence); territory assignments and market universe change at planning cycles. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window.

artifacts.name: pipeline_coverage
artifacts.fresh_means: Reports and logged checkpoints exist for the mid-quarter reference date, with every reconciliation to the quota panel and the forecast artifact passing.
artifacts.sla_rationale: The CRO reads coverage every week, so the operating cadence is weekly, but the artifact is evaluated at a fixed mid-quarter point so quarters are comparable. The canonical checkpoint is mid-quarter (2025-11-14, the same point and the same reason as the forecast: the last point with a large enough open Commercial/Enterprise population to read before the data window ends); it sits 16 days behind the last complete month. 21 days = three weekly cycles. Owner review item: a tighter SLA needs a later canonical checkpoint.

artifacts.name: tam_icp_sizing
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date against the current market universe.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Strategic and market-facing (build spec Wave 5); runs off the static market universe, refreshed with planning. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window.

artifacts.name: pricing_packaging
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged for the last complete month over the trailing 12-month windows it compares.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Strategic (build spec Wave 5); its trailing-12-versus-prior-12-month comparisons move slowly. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window, anchored to the last complete month because its canonical checkpoint is month-end.

artifacts.name: retention_cohorts
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date covering every acquisition vintage.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Cohorts are quarterly acquisition vintages; a vintage's curve only changes as months age, and renewal cliffs land on contract anniversaries. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window.

artifacts.name: lead_scoring_validation
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date against matured lead-conversion outcomes.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Validating discrimination needs matured conversion outcomes (a lead's outcome is not knowable for months), so a quarterly refresh captures everything new. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window.

artifacts.name: experimentation_platform
artifacts.fresh_means: Reports and logged checkpoints exist for the reference date and the prior checkpoint, and the platform reproduces the published holdout result.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Experiments read out when their assignment cohorts mature; the registered holdout program is evaluated quarterly. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window.

artifacts.name: mmm_incrementality
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged at the reference date over the full monthly spend series.
artifacts.sla_rationale: A monthly time series only adds a point per month and the regression is underpowered at 36 months (methods doc), so refitting more often than quarterly would change nothing. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day close window.

artifacts.name: variance_diagnostic
artifacts.fresh_means: A validation checkpoint is logged for the last complete month.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Every dollar and ARR node it walks is monthly-only (dashboard grain table), so it cannot be fresher than a month close. One month plus a 4-day close window. The final simulated month is truncated, so its canonical checkpoint is the last complete month.

artifacts.name: scenario_planning
artifacts.fresh_means: A checkpoint is logged for the last complete month's metric-tree baseline.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Propagates hypothetical input changes through the monthly tree equations, so its baseline is the last month close. One month plus a 4-day close window.

artifacts.name: playbook_triggers
artifacts.fresh_means: The trigger log has been evaluated through the reference week, so every fired trigger carries an outcome knowable by then.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Trigger rules read weekly-capable event sources (activity, stage history, workflow chains), and an unworked trigger is only useful inside its SLA clock. One week plus a 3-day slip.

artifacts.name: weekly_readout
artifacts.fresh_means: A readout JSON/Markdown pair exists for the last complete month, its trigger section was built from the current playbook log, and its forecast section carries the forecast call current at that month end (or declares itself unavailable with a reason), each drill-down carries its persistence record, and its segment-mix section is read from the marts at that month (or declares itself unavailable with a reason).
artifacts.sla_rationale: Weekly operating cadence (build spec Section 8, Wave 1). One week plus a 3-day slip. The scorecard inside it is monthly-only (dashboard grain table), so it is anchored to the last complete month rather than the truncated final month.

artifacts.name: executive_summary
artifacts.fresh_means: The narrative step has evaluated the readout for the last complete month: it either published a grounding-validated summary or recorded, in the readout's executive_summary slot and in the performance log (narrative_generated = 0), that none was generated. Fresh does NOT mean prose exists: a run without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is fresh and reports not_generated (reason no_api_key), so a missing key never turns the contract red but is never hidden either -- read narrative_generated in the performance log or executive_summary.status in the readout JSON.
artifacts.sla_rationale: The step runs immediately after weekly_readout in every pipeline run and is only meaningful against that run's readout, so it inherits the weekly readout's cadence and SLA: one week plus a 3-day slip.

artifacts.name: proxy_metric_health
artifacts.fresh_means: Reports and logged checkpoints exist for the reference date, counted after every other artifact's checkpoint was written.
artifacts.sla_rationale: A governance catalog over the performance log; the drift-monitor cadence it feeds is monthly (agent definition). Runs last so it counts every other artifact's checkpoints. One month plus a 4-day close window.

artifacts.name: raw_data
artifacts.fresh_means: The monthly-grain billing table reaches the reference month and the event-grain CRM and marketing tables reach within a month of the reference date.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Every dollar and ARR figure downstream is monthly-only (dashboard grain table), so raw data is complete once the month closes; month-start keyed rows are at most one month old, plus a 4-day close window. The committed dataset is a fixed simulation whose horizon is the dbt analysis_as_of_date; regenerating it does not move that horizon.

artifacts.name: dbt_marts
artifacts.fresh_means: data/acme_gtm.duckdb exists and each core mart reaches the reference month; built from the raw data currently on disk by dbt build with all tests passing.
artifacts.sla_rationale: Marts carry the same monthly grain as the raw data they model, so they are as current as the last month close: one month plus a 4-day close window. The database is gitignored and rebuilt from scratch, so a missing file is reported as missing, not stale.

artifacts.name: model_performance_log
artifacts.fresh_means: The append-only checkpoint log has a row at or near the reference date (every analytics run upserts into it).
artifacts.sla_rationale: Written by every artifact run, so it should move with every pipeline run; checked at one week plus a 3-day slip. Staleness here means the pipeline has not been run, not that any one artifact is late.

artifacts.name: semantic_registry
artifacts.fresh_means: Regenerating the registry from docs/acme-corp-gtm-metric-tree.md would produce identical content (tree hash stamped, or parsed content equal).
artifacts.sla_rationale: The registry is a parse of the tree, so it must change in the same commit as the tree; zero tolerance. Measured by content, not by date.

artifacts.name: dashboard_readout_input
artifacts.fresh_means: The Digest page has a readout JSON for the last complete month to render.
artifacts.sla_rationale: The Digest renders the readout verbatim, so it is exactly as current as the weekly readout: one week plus a 3-day slip.

artifacts.name: dashboard_status_manifest
artifacts.fresh_means: The component-status manifest that gates what each dashboard page may render live was reviewed within the last quarter.
artifacts.sla_rationale: A hand-maintained projection of the build state; it changes when an artifact's status changes, which is rare, so a quarterly review is the backstop. A 92-day quarter plus a 7-day window.

library_modules.analytics.model_performance: Append-only performance-log writer; its freshness is the model_performance_log artifact.
